subject: [hw] K02 -> K01: shared-VEN prototypes as implemented (match your n2jd_share_ven)
body:
For the record, the two prototypes the task asked us to agree are implemented as:

  int  n2vc_ven_get(void);    /* first reference runs the full VEN power-on (SPM 0x344 bit 17, venc_sel, gates 0/4/28, larb7); returns 0 or -errno */
  void n2vc_ven_put(void);    /* drops the reference; the last one powers VEN down */

and the registration your driver already uses is:

  int n2jd_share_ven(int (*get)(void), void (*put)(void));   /* EINVAL for NULL, EBUSY while a JPEG job is in flight */

Your nord2_jpegdev.inc:81-97/613 matches (typedef int (*)(void) / void (*)(void)), the combined TU compiles with -Wall -Wextra -Werror, and the "do not enable gate bit 8 (JPGENC)" rule holds: n2vc_ven_get enables only vencsys bits 0, 4, 28. No change needed from you.
